title: Cone font
description: Minecraft is cubic, why aren't the font too ?
body:
Cone font on Minecraft.

![abc test](https://d144mzi0q5mijx.cloudfront.net/img/C/O/Cone.webp) [](https://www.curseforge.com/members/kentapainter/projects)[](https://discord.gg/C47W2vcKX)[]() It only change game's font.

### Installation This file goes in the resourcepacks folder, just like any other texturepack. It's activated in the same way as a texture pack.

> **Tip:** If you have multiple texture packs active, place this file on top of them all to apply the font to everything.
